stress_cell_lira_vs_conf.observation: On the controlled stress cell, conf AUROC ≈0.79 while LiRA ≈0.50. Likely causes: (1) membership signal is concentrated in max-confidence / entropy features that LR-φ exploits, while Gaussian LiRA on full logits is under-separated when Acc is near chance and class posteriors are diffuse; (2) n_shadows=4 with highly overfit targets yields noisy shadow likelihoods; (3) primary protocol metric is LiRA — this cell is a *stress test for conf AUROC*, not a LiRA-positive Volume finding.
